## Configuring the Oauth 2.0 Playground for QuickBooks Online

Everything you need to know about how to use our Oauth 2.0 playground. https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization/oauth-2.0-playground

- Mar 13, 2019
- Support Community

### Information

Article Body

# Prerequisites

- [Create an Intuit Developer account](https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/get-started) or sign on to your existing account.
- [Create an app](https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/get-started) if you haven’t already done so that configures the Accounting, and optionally the Payments, data source.
- [Go to the OAuth2 Playground](https://developer.intuit.com/v2/ui#/playground).

# Get the access token

Invoke the OAuth 2.0 playground on your app’s dashboard to authorize the connection between your app and the QuickBooks company. The playground uses its own OAuth redirect URI for the authorization request.

1. Select scopes. On the OAuth 2.0 Playground dialog click the **Select Scopes** drop-down list and choose desired scopes. In the animation below, the OAuth scope, **Accounting**, is selected.
2. Get the authorization code. Click the **Get Authorization Code** button and then the **Authorize** button on the connection dialog to initiate the company authorization workflow. The next playground section, Get Tokens from Authorization Code, is populated with the authorization code and company ID.
3. Exchange code for access token. In the **Get Tokens from Authorization Code** section, click the **Get Tokens** button to finish the authorization process. The response payload contains the access token for use in subsequent API calls and the refresh token to use when refreshing the access token.  From here, use the playground to make API calls or refresh the access token.

![qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization/OAuth2Playground.gif](https://static.developer.intuit.com/images/OAuth2Playground.gif)

# Troubleshooting

One common issue people face when using the OAuth2 Playground is that their App does not have the proper redirect URI set.  In this situation you will see this error when attempting to get the authorization code:

![User-added image](https://help.developer.intuit.com/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka20f000000kA3X&feoid=00NG000000EnUuh&refid=0EM0f000000kuRq)

There is a handy, albeit small, link in the playground that will set your redirect URI for you.

![User-added image](https://help.developer.intuit.com/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka20f000000kA3X&feoid=00NG000000EnUuh&refid=0EM0f000000kuRv)

You can also set the Redirect URI manually by navigating to your app -> keys section and setting the Redirect URI to: [https://developer.intuit.com/v2/OAuth2Playground/RedirectUrl](https://developer.intuit.com/v2/OAuth2Playground/RedirectUrl).

For more information on the Oauth 2.0 playground please [click here](https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization/oauth-2.0-playground).
